verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses telemetry, usage tracking, analytics data collection, or any opt-out mechanism for AI-native or developer usage; all evidence covers financial product features, APIs, SDKs, and AI agent connectors. Missing for 10: any privacy policy or settings documentation regarding telemetry/usage data collection, an opt-out control or setting, and any statement about what usage data Airwallex collects from its APIs/SDKs/CLI.
